prediction.effectSizeReason: The contract forbids transferring the Hare effect size, and no band was added after development results were seen.

decisionRule.supported: Held-out mean is greater than zero and at least 3 of 5 paired differences are positive, with all evidence valid.
decisionRule.notTransferred: Held-out mean is zero or negative, evidence is invalid, or fewer than 3 pairs are positive unless the result qualifies as unresolved.
decisionRule.unresolved: Held-out mean is positive but fewer than 3 pairs are positive, or another preregistered validity condition is incomplete.
